planning_notes: Uno board with authoritative wiring preserved: HC-SR04 TRIG=D8, ECHO=D9; TM1637 CLK=D4, DIO=D5.

Ultrasonic requests use hardware timeout_us=25000 (lower bound) to satisfy the 'each wait must have 25000us超时' requirement; exact 60..160ms sampling start spacing and <=250ms end-to-end latency are handled in SysML timing.

Quantization to integer centimeters, blanking behavior on timeout/out-of-range/echo-stuck, and validity-vs-distance separation are handled in the SysML model: ultrasonic_valid drives whether tm1637_number shows blank vs the latest retained ultrasonic_distance.
TM1637 initial startup blanking is implemented by requesting an out-of-display-range initial value (10000) together with invalid_policy='blank'; leading_zero is false.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: HC-SR04 measured distance in cm (model quantizes/display state; retained previous value on invalid)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Validity flag for HC-SR04 distance (false on timeout/out-of-range/echo stuck); retained policy applies to distance only

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 display command for distance-in-cm; initial out-of-range requests blank per model; show integer cm when valid

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
使用 TM1637 + HC-SR04（D8/D9）：显示距离
验收约定：目标板Uno；HC-SR04 TRIG=D8、ECHO=D9，TM1637 CLK=D4、DIO=D5。距离以cm为单位，回波微秒数除58；有效范围2..400cm，显示整数厘米（量化容差1cm，前导零或空白均可）。采样开始间隔60..160ms，变化250ms内反映（包含测量等待和显示传输）。每次等待回波必须有25000us超时；无回波、卡高或越界时显示空白，恢复后继续显示真实距离。初始显示空白；测量值和有效性必须区分，不得将超时当成0cm。原需求未指定的CLK/DIO采用上述公开接线，各组相同。
